ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: SW — Bestiary (Mlie Sound Absorption)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description: MLIE_FAUNA_ABSORPTION_1 — absorbed audio from `mlie.starwarsanimalcollection` (Star Wars Animal Collection), owner ruling 2026-09-02: "Absorb all the sounds absolutely." 589 SoundDefs (per-creature Angry/Wounded/Death/Call vocal sets across 143+ creatures, plus ability sounds), extracted from the donor's AssetBundle and re-hosted here under an `RSW_` prefix. Sound-only this pass — the creature ThingDef/PawnKindDef geometry (Wave A/B/C) is separate, still-open work in the same item; this mod is the intended eventual home for that content too, so the audio lands in the right place from the start.
